1. Updated `packages/app/tsconfig.json` to use proper project references (`references: [{ "path": "../core" }]`) instead of path mapping to source files. This allows TypeScript to correctly resolve the dependency through the built output.

2. Changed the import in `packages/app/src/main.ts` from `@core/index.js` to `../../core/dist/index.js` so the emitted JavaScript can resolve the module at runtime without node_modules.

3. Added a null check for `shape` in `report()` to satisfy strict TypeScript checking (since `findShape` returns `Shape | undefined`).

The build now passes and `node packages/app/dist/main.js` produces the expected output:
```

circle has 0 sides and an area of 12.57
```
